First, 36 weeks + 7 days = 36 weeks + 1 week = 37 weeks.  
37 weeks = 37 × 7 = 259 days.  

Start date: 1203-03-07 (assuming format DD-MM-YYYY means 7 March 1203).  
Add 259 days:  
March has 31 days → from March 7: 31 - 7 = 24 days left in March → 259 - 24 = 235 remaining.  
April (30) → 235 - 30 = 205.  
May (31) → 205 - 31 = 174.  
June (30) → 174 - 30 = 144.  
July (31) → 144 - 31 = 113.  
August (31) → 113 - 31 = 82.  
September (30) → 82 - 30 = 52.  
October (31) → 52 - 31 = 21.  
November 1203 has 30 days → 21 days into November = November 21, 1203.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1203-11-21
